title: Prism pattern spec
description: Contract for one Prism pattern, a screen-level recipe (layer 4, ADR-0012). Applied to spec/patterns/*.yaml. A pattern is documented with anatomy and token bindings like a component (ADR-0012 rule 3), so every field it shares with one is spec/component.schema.json's own definition, referenced rather than copied: the token-path alternation of ADR-0024 §5.3 keeps its single copy. It adds the recipe - `layout`, `rules` and `composition` - and it has no implementation manifest entry. See spec/patterns/README.md for intent; tools/spec/validate.ts checks what JSON Schema cannot (token paths, the binding-matrix axes, prose, examples and the composed specs).

layer.description: Every file under spec/patterns/ is layer 4 (ADR-0012).

tokens.description: What the pattern paints or places itself, in the component binding grammar. A pattern binds sys roles only: component tokens belong to components (ADR-0024 §5.2), and every value a composed component owns stays that component's cell.

layout.description: The recipe's geometry: breakpoints, column counts, spans, gaps and region sizes. A value is a token path, a number, a sentence that names its research section, or a mapping of them keyed by width class or variant. Token paths here must resolve like prose.

rules.description: The counting and placement rules an agent must keep when it assembles the screen (one hero, one accent, …); token paths here must resolve like prose.

composition.description: The specs the pattern composes, the props it fixes on each, what it forwards to them and where each goes. `component` names a spec under spec/components/ or spec/patterns/, and every prop it sets is a prop that spec declares, with a value its type allows.

props.description: The props the pattern sets on the composed spec; the rest are the app's.

forwards.description: The composed spec's props and slots the pattern passes through, and where their values come from.

where.description: The part of this pattern's anatomy the composed spec fills, and under which condition.
